2609.02149.title: OmegaUse-SOP: SOP Engineering for Professional Computer Use from Human Demonstrations
2609.02149.paper_summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly evolving from conversational assistants into agents capable of operating external digital environments. Graphical user interface (GUI) agents play an important role in this transition, as many real-world workflows remain accessible only through user-facing software interfaces. However, despite recent progress on general computer-use benchmarks, domain-specific professional standard operating procedures (SOPs) remain challenging for GUI agents because they often involve implicit domain knowledge, software-specific conventions, and task-level verification requirements. We introduce OmegaUse-SOP, a human-in-the-loop SOP Engineering system for transforming human demonstrations of professional computer use into reusable SOP skills for GUI agents. Analogous to prompt engineering, SOP Engineering iteratively refines demonstrations, execution rules, and domain knowledge to convert professional SOPs into reusable GUI-agent skills. OmegaUse-SOP consists of four modules: Observe, Reason, Configure, and Execute. Together, these modules record expert operations as multimodal GUI traces, abstract low-level events into semantic step-level instructions, incorporate domain rules and task-specific parameters, and execute the resulting skills in live GUI environments through step-wise grounding, action generation, and verification. To demonstrate its effectiveness, we collaborate with a power-sector client and test OmegaUse-SOP on photovoltaic simulation workflows in PVsyst 7.2. The results suggest that OmegaUse-SOP can improve GUI-agent reliability on professional SOP tasks, highlighting a practical path toward deploying GUI agents in domain-specific professional software environments.
2609.02149.paper_summary_zh: 大型語言模型（LLMs）正逐漸從對話助手演變為能夠操作外部數位環境的代理。圖形使用者介面（GUI）代理在這一過程中扮演著重要角色，因為許多現實世界的工作流程仍然只能通過面向使用者的軟體介面來訪問。然而，儘管在一般電腦使用基準上取得了近期進展，針對特定領域的專業標準作業程序（SOP）對於GUI代理來說仍然具有挑戰性，因為這些程序通常涉及隱含的領域知識、軟體特定的慣例以及任務級的驗證要求。我們介紹了OmegaUse-SOP，一個人機協作的SOP工程系統，用於將人類對專業電腦使用的示範轉換為可重用的GUI代理SOP技能。類似於提示工程，SOP工程迭代地精煉示範、執行規則和領域知識，以將專業SOP轉換為可重用的GUI代理技能。OmegaUse-SOP由四個模組組成：觀察、推理、配置和執行。這些模組共同記錄專家操作作為多模態GUI痕跡，將低級事件抽象為語義步驟級指令，納入領域規則和任務特定參數，並通過逐步基礎、行動生成和驗證在實時GUI環境中執行生成的技能。為了證明其有效性，我們與一家電力部門的客戶合作，並在PVsyst 7.2中測試OmegaUse-SOP的光伏模擬工作流程。結果表明，OmegaUse-SOP可以提高GUI代理在專業SOP任務上的可靠性，突顯了在特定領域專業軟體環境中部署GUI代理的實際途徑。
